bullets.text: Halvern Dam and the right abutment were damaged.
Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark, and people were evacuated from Ferris Hollow and the alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange.
Brindlemark Police deployed to Brindlemark as response operations continued. Sorrel Basin Water Authority provided information during emergency communications.
On September 10, a mandatory evacuation was ordered for Brindlemark and Ferris Hollow and the alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange.
On September 10, 12,400 people were evacuated from Brindlemark, and people were evacuated from Quennard.
Halvern Dam and the right abutment were damaged.
Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark, and people were evacuated from Ferris Hollow and the alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange.
People were evacuated from Brindlemark during evacuation and displacement operations.
People were displaced from Quennard during evacuation and displacement operations.
Brindlemark Police deployed to Brindlemark as response operations continued.
Assistance was provided in Quennard as response operations continued.
Sorrel Basin Water Authority provided information during emergency communications.
